description: Returns the stored court and tribunal AI instruments that match a task and a forum, using the catalogue rule matcher.

forum.description: A forum code such as ncat or federal-court. Omit it to be asked which court applies.

jurisdiction.description: Optional code: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT or CTH (use CTH for federal forums such as the Federal Court, FCFCOA and the Fair Work Commission). Omit it to be asked. No code is filled in for you.

task.description: The legal task, in a short phrase, with client names removed.

name: find_rules
title: Find court AI rules
